objectives.label: Find the robbers' camp on the road to {other} and break it

title: The robbers on the {other} road
Avenge the caravan
summary: Bandits robbed the caravan from {other} on the road, {distance} to the {direction}. {giver} wants them found and their camp broken.
offer: They took {cargo} and left the drovers bleeding in the ditch. Their camp is somewhere on the road to {other}, {direction} of here. Break it.
progress: Are the robbers still out there?
complete: The road to {other} is ours again. Thank you.
